changelog:
- Initial release of the Product Pose Prompt Generator.
- Generates detailed English image prompts for front-view characters holding products, based on user text and image inputs.
- Analyzes key elements: product details, character features, pose, background, and reference images.
- Ensures concise, expressive prompts that include all user specifications.
- Outputs only the English prompt, formatted as requested, with a 300-word maximum.
summary: Generate English image prompts for front-view product-holding character images based on user-provided text descriptions and image assets.
